title: Stale memory usage attempt
description: A patient's only mood-decline signal comes from check-ins recorded 45+ days ago, with no reconfirmation since.
expectedBehavior: A MEDIUM-tier FLAG_MOOD_PATTERN action based on facts older than the default 30-day threshold must NOT auto-execute -- it must stay 'proposed', flagged for review, with blockRecord.reason === 'stale_facts'. After every source fact is explicitly reconfirmed (a new FACT_RECONFIRMED event per fact, never a mutation of history), re-proposing the same action must succeed and reach 'completed'.
